messages:
tess: Noticed a puzzling UX issue: Go and Ruby SDKs are dropping status codes when we wrap transport errors. Sample app retries based on status and now behaves differently across languages.
raj: Oof. Which transport errors? timeouts or connection resets?
tess: Both. Example: when auth refresh fails we see net/http timeout in go and Faraday::Timeout in ruby. The wrapper code does `raise SDK::Error, e.message` and we lose structured fields.
mike: That's the same pattern we've seen in Python earlier. Wrapping without preserving attributes is the root cause. We should enforce a small SDK guideline: always preserve original status, code, and request_id in the wrapper.
olga: Proposed minimal contract for wrappers: error.code (enum), error.status (int or null), error.raw (original exception string), error.hint (nullable). For languages without exception attributes (older ruby versions), attach metadata to the error object via instance vars.
tess: Example pseudo-ruby fix:```ruby
begin
  client.call
rescue Faraday::TimeoutError => e
  raise SDK::TimeoutError.new("Request timed out", status: nil, code: "TIMEOUT", raw: e.message)
end
```
raj: Can we also propagate retry-after when present? Even for network-level failures we can set retryable=true or false heuristically.
mike: Yes. Let's standardize fields: code, status, message, retryable, retry_hint, request_id, raw. Recommend `retryable` tri-state: "yes"|"no"|"unknown" to avoid false confidence.
olga: We should add a small integration test in the sample app harness that intentionally injects transport failures and asserts the SDK error exposes those fields. That will catch regressions in wrappers.
tess: CI note: some older integration tests expect plain string errors; we'll need to update them.
ci-bot: job 1245 failed: sample-app-integration (ruby) — see logs: https://ci.redwood/1245/logs
raj: I'll take the CI fix to update expectations. Also we should add a lint rule for Go that ensures `errors.Wrap` preserves cause and metadata via our SDKerror type.
mike: I'll add a small SDK util `sdk.IsRetryable(err)` and `sdk.GetStatus(err)` to minimize per-app parsing. Also plan to publish a small "error-handling" sample in the quickstart repo.
olga: For release notes: call out the breaking change for existing apps that assumed string-based message parsing. Provide migration snippet.
tess: Owners: @mike will add util + docs, @raj will update ruby sample/CI, @olga will prepare release note, @tess will add integration tests. Target: 2 weeks, but let's get CI fixes in ASAP.
raj: PR up for CI fix: https://github.com/redwood-inference/sample-apps/pull/452 (WIP).
mike: Reminder: runtime should send canonical envelope even for connection-level errors where possible; for pure TCP fails, include best-effort envelope in SDK layer.
tess: Thanks team — this is a small ergonomics win but reduces lots of flaky onboarding calls. :raised_hands:
